## Grading {#grading}

Everything is out of **100 marks**, with bonus marks on top.

```{=html}
<table class="t" data-quarto-disable-processing="true">
<thead><tr><th>Component</th><th>Marks</th><th>How</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><th>Project</th><td class="big">40</td><td>In groups of four or fewer: proposal report (5), phase I presentation (5), phase II presentation (5), three-minute pitch in the style of 3MT (5), demo and poster (15) and final report (5).</td></tr>
<tr><th>Homework</th><td class="big">32</td><td>Eight programming assignments, 4 marks each. Late submissions earn 50% credit: up to one day late for the first assignment and up to two days for the others. A subset has an associated viva.</td></tr>
<tr><th>End semester</th><td class="big">10</td><td>Written exam.</td></tr>
<tr><th>Quizzes</th><td class="big">6</td><td>Three surprise quizzes worth 3 marks each; the best two count.</td></tr>
<tr><th>Paper presentation</th><td class="big">4</td><td>Three students per paper: one summarises it, one argues for it, one acts as devil's advocate. <a href="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/19X7uj0evg1aCV_iVnrrZjquG6jr5Qdpg06TqvNiPvTE/edit#gid=0">Paper list</a> · <a href="https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1IOb5osggH6rGzJmS3f7drlGJAk3WzhmCpnDHecOzoPI/edit#slide=id.g4d46f3c2cc_0_55">slides template</a>.</td></tr>
<tr><th>Kaggle competition</th><td class="big">4</td><td>Done individually, due in early April.</td></tr>
<tr><th>ML demo</th><td class="big">4</td><td>An interactive demo, in the same team as the project, due 30 March. Examples: <a href="http://stanford.edu/class/ee103/visualizations/kmeans/kmeans.html">k-means</a>, <a href="http://www.r2d3.us/visual-intro-to-machine-learning-part-1/">a visual introduction to ML</a>, <a href="https://www.saedsayad.com/flash/SLR.html">linear regression</a>, <a href="https://cs.stanford.edu/people/karpathy/svmjs/demo/demoforest.html">random forests</a>.</td></tr>
<tr><th>Total</th><td class="big">100</td><td>Bonus: 10 marks for reaching Master level on Kaggle, or 5 marks for Expert level.</td></tr>
</tbody></table>
```

:::

::: {.two .rule-top}
